description: The spawn lock is a plain create_new file with no stale-lock recovery. If the spawning client dies before cleanup, later invocations can fail to respawn the daemon until the lock is removed manually.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change de8865016485. Spawn-lock acquisition now recovers stale lock files after the daemon connect timeout window instead of leaving manual cleanup as the only recovery path. Verification: cargo test -p raql-daemon && cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Recover stale daemon spawn locks after interrupted startup
